scope: ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 §§8.3 Coordinate systems, 8.4.1 General, 8.4.2 Graphics state stack, and Table 56 in 8.4.4; with Table 31 /MediaBox, /CropBox, /Rotate, /UserUnit where needed for the page initial transform. Primary effective layout: scratchpad/r2038/spec-audit/ec3-parent-layout.txt. Printed pages: Figure 9 p.148; user-space definition p.150; matrix composition pp.155-156; Table 51 pp.157-158 and Table 52 p.159; stack p.160; Table 56 pp.164-165; Table 31 page geometry p.121.

features.feature: CTM coordinates and cm concatenation; q/Q stack save/restore
features.source: §8.3.2.3-.4, §8.3.4 (printed pp.150-156); §8.4.2 and Table 56 (pp.160, 164-165). Figure 9 (§8.2, printed p.148) defines legal operator context: q/Q and cm are graphics-state operators at content-stream level, outside a path object.
features.implementation: pdf-model/src/content.rs::GraphicsState::initial; content/run/graphics.rs::run_graphics_state_op, where `cm` updates `matrix.then(state.transform)` and q/Q clone/pop GraphicsState. pdf-render/src/geom.rs::Transform::then documents application order. Current path is a separate Machine field.
features.test_evidence: `pdf-model/tests/image_coordinates_audit.rs` checks direct CM placement, reflection, skew and visible sample locations, but only one cm at a time. `content.rs` unit tests map all four page corners for Rotate. `graphics_stack_paths_audit.rs::a_clip_keeps_the_ctm_in_force_when_w_is_applied` inspects a clip's transform across a later cm. `line_parameters.rs::the_stack_saves_and_restores_them` tests q/Q restoration of cap/join/miter at content-stream level; nested clip tests check Q restoration. `geom.rs::then_applies_self_before_other` tests Transform's generic order but not the PDF content operator route. Exclude `graphics_stack_paths_audit.rs::q_and_q_operators_leave_the_current_path_outside_the_stack` as source-conformance evidence: it is retained only as a robustness/recovery-policy witness because q/Q occur inside an open path object.
features.assessment: Existing evidence covers the constituent transformations and many visible consumers. A gap remains in a single independent, valid page-level assertion that composes two noncommuting cm operators with non-origin CropBox, Rotate and UserUnit, then checks Q restored the initial CTM. Draft `drafts/coordinate_graphics_state.rs` supplies exact-xref state and raster controls; uncompiled/unrun.
features.residuals: Does not certify all PDF coordinate spaces or inverse-dependent mark consumers. A graphics-state operator inside an open path object is prohibited by Figure 9 and cannot be used as a valid-input conformance witness. Suggested feature/test-comment correction for the retained q/Q mid-path test is recorded in decisions.json; do not remove the recovery-policy assertion.

features.feature: Page initial user-to-display mapping and defaults for CropBox, Rotate, UserUnit
features.source: §8.3.2.3: CropBox identifies visible default-user-space region; axes are x-right/y-up, adjusted by Rotate; UserUnit sets unit size and defaults 1 (printed p.150). Table 31 supplies Rotate and UserUnit (printed p.121); §7.7.3.4 controls inheritance.
features.implementation: pdf-model/src/page.rs::build_page inherits nearest CropBox/Rotate, defaults crop to media, reads non-inheritable UserUnit on leaf; content.rs::displayed_size and base_transform subtract display-box origin, rotate clockwise and scale by UserUnit.
features.test_evidence: `page_geometry.rs::a_user_unit_scales_the_page_and_its_contents` asserts page dimensions and a black mark at scaled pixel coordinates; `a_page_stated_in_inches_is_the_size_those_inches_are` uses `/UserUnit 72`; `a_user_unit_on_an_ancestor_is_not_inherited` distinguishes inheritable MediaBox/Rotate from leaf-only UserUnit. `inherited_crop_box_reaches_the_rendered_page_and_a_leaf_can_override_it` asserts dimensions and margin pixels for offset inherited and overriding crop values. `content.rs` unit tests assert clockwise corner mappings at all four valid rotations.
features.assessment: Substantive source-derived coverage exists for CropBox offset/default/inheritance, all legal Rotate values at the mapping helper, and UserUnit size/content scaling. The proposed integration draft composes all three with cm and Q to check their interaction at the public display-list/raster boundary.
features.residuals: Invalid/non-multiple Rotate and unsupported UserUnit bounds are implementation policy where the standard gives no required recovery or explicitly leaves range implementation-dependent; no claim that their current normalization/default choice is mandated. The default ClipBox's visible effect is tested through output target boundaries; it is not represented as an explicit clip node in GraphicsState.

features.feature: Selected initial graphics-state defaults and q/Q behavior
features.source: §8.4.1 Tables 51-52 (printed pp.157-159) state CTM, initial MediaBox clip, gray/black, line width 1, butt cap, miter join, miter limit 10, solid dash, RelativeColorimetric, SA false, Normal blend, no soft mask, alpha 1, AIS false, BlackPoint Default; device-specific transfer/BG/UCR/halftone/smoothness, flatness 1. §8.4.2 says q pushes a copy of the entire state and Q restores it, LIFO (p.160).
features.implementation: content.rs::GraphicsState::initial and pdf-render/src/paint.rs::Stroke::default; Machine stack stores cloned GraphicsState (plus §9.4.2 text matrices where in text). Target/medium impose page bounds; the display-list state starts with the MediaBox-derived page transform.
features.test_evidence: `extgstate_missing_line_keys_audit.rs::the_initial_line_parameters_match_table_51` asserts width=1, cap Butt, join Miter, miter=10 and solid dash. `line_parameters.rs` asserts the three line style defaults and q/Q restoration. `graphics_stack_paths_audit.rs` checks initial page-boundary clipping and valid nested clip restoration. `rendering_intent.rs` covers intent-driven conversion; `extgstate_defaults_audit.rs` covers some device-specific transfer/smoothness choices.
features.assessment: Selected common defaults have direct assertions, but this is not a census of every Table 51/52 state value or every q/Q-restored property. Reader's chosen defaults for parameters the source makes device-dependent should not be described as ISO constants.
features.residuals: Existing default clip is realized by viewport/target clipping rather than GraphicsState.clip=Some(MediaBox); this is observably equivalent for current display pipeline but not every downstream internal consumer was reviewed. Not all alpha, colour-space, transfer, text, or device-dependent values were reaudited here.
